name: Runemaster Wizardry raises Intellect by 10% and adds mana equal to 10% of Intellect (#547)
contract: Wizardry 705632 (Arcane talent, passive): 'Increases your Intellect by $s1% and increases the mana gained for
each point of Intellect by $s2%.' Effect 0 is aura 137 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, MiscValue 3
MiscValue 0 (mana), MiscValueB 3 (Intellect), 10%. Aura 328 carries exactly the same encoding in Ancient Rites
301368 ('Increases your mana by $s2% of your Intellect'), Arcane Recovery 1112474 and Boon of Y'shaarj 560080, so
its amount is a percentage of Intellect added to maximum mana (sun-cleric-ancient-rites,
Expected: Intellect rises by 10%; maximum mana rises by the native 15 mana per point of the added Intellect plus
10% of the new Intellect, i.e. about 16.1 mana per added point (exactly 15 without effect 1, about 31.5 if
effect 1 multiplied the 15 mana per point). Unlearning restores both.
